t3: Higher Education in Multiplatform Application Development

descriptions.d1: Full-stack Developer position at Atos/Eviden, participating in the development and maintenance of enterprise applications. I have worked on creating microservices with Spring Boot in the backend and developing interfaces with Angular and React in the frontend. Additionally, I have implemented REST APIs and used tools like Docker and Kubernetes for service management and orchestration, applying best practices for code quality and security in applications.
descriptions.d2: I completed a bootcamp where I worked on Full-stack projects with Angular and Spring Boot, using JPA for database management. I participated in the integration of APIs, data validation, and communication between frontend and backend. I also gained experience in teamwork, debugging, problem-solving, and the entire software development cycle, applying agile methodologies.
descriptions.d3: Studies in Multiplatform Application Development, with training in Java, JavaScript, React, and Spring Boot, as well as SQL databases and JPA. I learned about database design and structure, development of responsive interfaces, and the creation of applications for desktop, web, and mobile. I also gained knowledge in software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies.
